cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.8)
project(g1_description)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# The model lives in <repo>/g1-brainco-description (single source of truth, generated by g1-brainco-description/build_model.py).
# This package only installs it:  share/g1_description/{urdf,meshes,mjcf,robot_spec.json}
# this package: <repo>/ros2_ws/src/hospital-sim-ros2/g1_description
set(G1_MODEL_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../g1-brainco-description/g1_29dof_brainco")
get_filename_component(G1_MODEL_DIR "${G1_MODEL_DIR}" REALPATH)
if(NOT EXISTS "${G1_MODEL_DIR}/urdf/g1_29dof_brainco_ros.urdf")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Robot model not found in ${G1_MODEL_DIR}; run g1-brainco-description/build_model.py")
endif()

install(DIRECTORY ${G1_MODEL_DIR}/urdf ${G1_MODEL_DIR}/meshes ${G1_MODEL_DIR}/mjcf
        DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(FILES ${G1_MODEL_DIR}/robot_spec.json DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(DIRECTORY launch DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_package()
